intro: Competing is half of what we do. The rest is making sure robotics does not stop at our build room door.

programs.title: School Demos
programs.description: We bring the robot into classrooms and assemblies so students can drive it themselves. For a lot of them it is the first time engineering looks like something they could actually do.

programs.title: Workshops
programs.description: Hands-on sessions on CAD, wiring, and programming, run by students for students.

programs.title: Mentoring
programs.description: We support newer and younger teams in our area with build advice, spare parts, and competition help.
